entries.name: Hook the Retreat
entries.effect: After an enemy voluntarily retreats from adjacent to 2 squares: pull 1.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Hook the Retreat

*The hooked limb follows the withdrawing foe, catching just as the space opens between them.*

After a visible enemy voluntarily moves from adjacent to this creature and ends that movement exactly 2 squares from it, pull that enemy 1 square toward this creature along a clear path. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules. No separate attack damage. Forced movement and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger this; it is an alternative to spending the Reaction on an opportunity attack.

details.flavorMarkdown: *A horned enforcer wears chains arranged like official regalia and carries a ledger protected from every spark.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Barbed chain

**Target:** One visible creature within 2 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Pull 3. **Standard defense:** Pull 1.

**Limit:** Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules to the printed distance.

### Mark the Boundary

*A sharp line of light marks a boundary across the floor.*

Place up to 3 connected empty ground squares within 3 squares as difficult terrain until its next turn. No damage, wall or prohibition against crossing; all creatures pay the same terrain costs.

### Hook the Retreat

*The hooked limb follows the withdrawing foe, catching just as the space opens between them.*

After a visible enemy voluntarily moves from adjacent to this creature and ends that movement exactly 2 squares from it, pull that enemy 1 square toward this creature along a clear path. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules. No separate attack damage. Forced movement and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger this; it is an alternative to spending the Reaction on an opportunity attack.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares; ordinary hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Pull the debtor toward a marked boundary, then exploit the slower crossing. The circle is difficult terrain, not an impassable prison.

**Encounter and conversation:** It is collecting on a real contract whose unfair clause may be challenged before an infernal witness.

**Habitat:** Broken shrine; summoned court; place of conflict · **Communication:** Common

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-horned-devil


**Category:** Fiend · **Role:** Position hunter · **CV:** 46

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Barbed chain | Brawn | 2 Boons | 4 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. Pull 1. | 10 physical damage. Pull 3. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 4/7/10

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.55

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.45 → 1.55: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=7.518. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [binding circle](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/binding-circle.md), [dragging strike](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/dragging-strike.md), [Hook the Retreat](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/hook-the-retreat.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.
